blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – A cargo vessel carrying more than 1,800 metric tons of soya ran aground off Tood Islet in Matalom, Leyte, on Wednesday, November 18, prompting the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) to deploy a rescue team and prepare equipment to prevent a possible oil spill. The MV GY Antares, operated by GY Shipping Lines Inc., was sailing from Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu, to Cagayan de Oro City when it ran aground while navigating the waters near the islet.
